judgment.reason: Raw startup-missing-executable control failed admission before transport. Other ten control observations and persistence supported assertions remain valid local observations; they do not make the combined phase pass.
judgment.source_review_correction: The frozen raw startup helper has four plain json.loads callsites outside the ordinary controller strict decoder. Three available retained raw CLI bodies contain no duplicate keys; the fourth after-start body was never produced. This separate prospective decoder gap did not cause the observed admission error.

limitations: All evidence is local trusted-controller retention and raw Engine traffic, not external attestation. No fresh daemon/socket/resource census was performed.
Cleanup is supported by exact created/inspected IDs, raw removal records and subsequent successful empty listings; it does not establish state outside those retained observations.
Attach/start request ordering is proven through cumulative checkpoint first occurrences. Raw frames corroborate byte identity; the audit does not independently measure socket/EOF wall-clock ordering.

Timeout retains an incomplete HTTP wait response and forged marker bytes without candidate completion authority. Overflow retains a genuine exit0 with unavailable/truncated output; neither becomes a product pass.

Historical source, runtime, limits and environment digests are bound across retained registration/intent/configuration. The historical parent environment itself is not independently reconstructed from the current shell.
The raw startup failure and permissive-parser source gap remain frozen and disclosed. No retries, retrospective result changes or candidate exit inference were performed.
No bulk histories, whole B03 acceptance, Registry bridge, repeatability, unseen candidate cohort, comparative statistical sample, speed advantage or cost advantage is established.
